chunks: 5266 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abd al-Aziz al-Abdi, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام:
Concerning a man who inflicted a mudihah wound on a slave, he عليه السلام said: “He is liable for half of one-tenth of his value.”

key_terms.شَجَّ: inflicted a head or facial wound
key_terms.مُوضِحَةً: a wound that exposes the bone
key_terms.نِصْفُ عُشْرِ قِيمَتِهِ: half of one-tenth of his market value as compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for inflicting a muwdihah wound on a slave in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on compensation for injuring a slave with a wound that exposes the bone. Imam Abu Abdillah عليه السلام states that the liable amount is half of one-tenth of the slave's monetary value.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5266 - Imam Abu Abdullah (as) was asked about a man who inflicted a mudhiha (a wound exposing the bone) on a slave.
Imam (as) said: "He is liable to pay half of one-tenth of the slave's value."
